svg.text: States per SPEC §7.2: in flight (thrown), landed, active, damaged (< 50% HP; code flickers the glow), destroyed (glow out, then scrap-ours). Drawn at 2×; shadows are code-drawn.
Shield on the bash arm (the hand that held the sword), full-size in every view, with shield-glow pieces. New attach point "shield" at the boss = bash impact. Banner group unchanged.
Option B: no sword at all
3 · Rally flag thrown · Warden jump slam · Ranger shockwave
Flag: one furled in-flight frame (tinted cloth + trim), code spins it. Warden: crouch, airborne, land made from the existing rig (no new parts). Shadow stays on the ground.

svg.text: red lane marker (code, D2): for context only
5 · Portals (theirs: violet-iron + violet) · replace the lane entries
Ground layer, anchored like the lane entries (edge midpoint between two tiles). Idle swirl; flare for ~1 s before a spawn (state frame + rising-spark effect). Code draws nothing extra.
Bottom portals sit in the bottom edge; side portals sit on the lower two-thirds of their edge (A2). Each footprint is 2 tiles wide, like the old lanes.
Effects layer; anchors at the ground point; ground rings are 0.6 ellipses; amber = ours, violet = theirs (Brute lock-on, portal flare).

New: act-shield, act-mine, act-beacon, role-*, card-build, card-tinkerer, base-hp. Replaced in place: main-commander, super-commander, super-ranger, super-warden (current version shown dimmed beside each).
8 · Ours vs theirs at TV size
Same 0.6 scale as the game: builds read as gunmetal + amber, portals as violet-iron + violet.
